nature: local durable table — NOT written to a Massive derived surface

CISD_FULL_STORE_CHECKSUM.test: VALID CISD rows occurring after the first UNAVAILABLE_CURRENT that follows the first VALID bar
CISD_FULL_STORE_CHECKSUM.meaning: the POST_GAP_RECOVERY = NONE_PROVEN contract holds on the real universe, not only on the synthetic fixture

CISD_NEGATIVE_FIXTURE.design: COMPLETE prefix, one gap, then a second segment of length 20 / 200 / 1,000 / 10,000
CISD_NEGATIVE_FIXTURE.result: VALID in segment 2 = 0 at every length
CISD_NEGATIVE_FIXTURE.secondary: later contaminated bars classify UNAVAILABLE_CURRENT, not INIT — "forever INIT" applies only to subsequent OBSERVED bars

L_SIG_FALLBACK_RECONCILIATION.significance: the per-row rule is doing real work: 21 fallback rows had every anchor and stayed VALID, 26 did not and were demoted. A per-column depth would have mis-classified all 47.

ANCHOR_COST_FULL_STORE.reading: the C1 pilot predicted this ordering; the full store confirms it. L43 is the expensive anchor and be_up inherits its cost through BE_UP_BX.

HEADLINE_FINDING.comparison: bounded WLNBB columns reach 37.85%; CISD reaches 3.50%
HEADLINE_FINDING.cause: the non-recoverable state contract restricts CISD to each security first contiguous COMPLETE run
HEADLINE_FINDING.INIT_HEAD_is_zero: CISD shows 0 INIT_HEAD because the head seed policy makes the first run VALID outright — the amendment that removed the zero-support contradiction is visibly in force

monitoring_defect_recorded: a polling loop reported a stale progress value for ~10 minutes because json.load failures inside a try/except silently retained the previous reading. The run was never stalled (99.2% CPU, growing output). Future stage runs emit a heartbeat with done/rows/current-ticker/elapsed/rows-per-sec, and the monitor must distinguish read-failure from unchanged-value.
